<!-- GENERATED by scripts/compile-contracts.mjs from contracts/rules. Edit the rule files, then run npm run contracts:compile. -->

- **invariant** `components/gate-account-feature-reading-rendering-place`: Gate an account feature by reading `useAuthState().needsSignIn` and rendering `SignInPrompt` in place of THAT feature - never block the app and never grow an app-wide gate. There is no login wall, ever, and an offline build with no backend configured must grow zero auth UI.
- **invariant** `components/keep-packages-out-they-retired-every`: Keep PACKAGES out of the UI: they are retired, every save is standalone in the flat library, and the ONE grouping is a PRODUCTION (`model/shows.ts`), so no surface copy, tooltip or menu may still offer one. Save and Home are both routed through `src/app/router.ts`, so browser Back and Forward walk between the surfaces.
- **invariant** `components/keep-selection-out-document-editor-state`: Keep SELECTION out of the document: it is editor UI state only, in the store's `selectedParts`, and the canvas, the timeline and the Inspector are three consumers of one selection. None of it is ever written into the template.
- **invariant** `components/never-report-save-storage-layer-has`: NEVER report a save the storage layer has not agreed to. The saved documents live in IndexedDB behind a synchronous mirror (`model/durableStore.ts`) which ACCEPTS a write and confirms it a moment later, so the value a model mutator returns means accepted, not landed. A surface that tells the reader anything about the outcome must `await commitDurableWrites()` first and CLAIM the message, and a flow that CONTINUES on success must await BEFORE the next step or it builds half a thing on a save that did not happen.
- **invariant** `components/render-editable-field-never-hand-roll`: Render an editable field with `fields/FieldControl` and never hand-roll a field control: the Data panel, the Control panel and the video Content panel all render that one component and differ only in the descriptors they pass.
- **rule** `components/background-write-reports-nothing-may-skip`: A background write that reports nothing may skip `commitDurableWrites` entirely, because the app-level dialog already announces unclaimed failures. Awaiting it in an autosave buys nothing and delays the next edit.
- **rule** `components/read-before-writing-dialog-markup-every`: Read `src/styles/AGENTS.md` before writing dialog markup: every dialog shares ONE anatomy defined in `src/styles/wizard-and-dialogs.css` - the header row with its hard-right close control, the checkbox row, the `110px | 1fr` form row, the one-row footer, and the `.spacer`-is-not-a-push trap. Do not restate or fork those rules in a component.
